summary: Resolved F01, D. N. Iesu Christi Regis (I classis), for Sunday 25 October 2026 against the 1962 facsimile page images (printed pp. 697-698, nos. 3938-3949, Sanctorale; proper Preface no. 1080, p. 291), RG 17 d / 91 row 3 / 111 a / 112 b and two dated Ordos: one branch for every Mass, no commemoration of the displaced Twenty-second Sunday or of Ss Chrysanthus and Daria, no added oration, white, Gloria, Credo, proper Preface. Wrote the complete ordered inventory (eleven elements said, plus the printed votive Tract and paschal Alleluia marked not said), Clementine wording comparison, lawful-route and source plan (Latin of this 1925 formulary has no settled publication basis yet; Lasance 1945 located for Latin/English of orations and Preface), shared-record defects, and remaining verification in research/context.md, and reserved main.tex with the scaffold comment.
